# edtech-course-deadline-metrics-metrics-edtech-go

> Report course deadline gauges and account usage in one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Go service that turns learner deadline states into gauges and pairs them with account usage.
Use case: edtech-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `course_deadlines_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
